PRs are welcome; missing acceptance can be resolved here before merge. No separate
CLA form or signing service is needed. Read [Contribution Terms v2 (2026-09-24)](https://github.com/adapt-toolkit/ours-network/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contribution-rights-and-acceptance).
